news.title: High number of new and inexperienced directors
news.body: There are 5 new directors who have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: 5 new directors. No experienced directors. No highly experienced directors. Non-Executive Director Rachita Agrawal is the most experienced director on the board, commencing their role in 2024. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Lack of board continuity. Lack of experienced directors.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹17.83 (vs ₹11.59 in FY 2025)
